message: cannot move `*r` out of a borrow or an index: its type is not `Copy`

fix.description: borrow it instead (`&*r`), or take the value out and leave another in its place with `mem.replace(&mut *r, other)` or `mem.swap` (`import std.mem;`)

related.label: captured by reference by this closure

fix.description: use `&d` inside the closure, or take the value out with `mem.replace(&mut d, other)` (`import std.mem;`)

message: `x` is used after an earlier operand of the same expression moved `x`

related.label: `x` moved here: operands are evaluated left to right

fix.description: compute the operand that uses `x` into a `let` before the expression and pass that local: operands are evaluated left to right, so `x` is gone when it runs

message: cannot move `q.d` out of `q`: a value that is not `Copy` moves whole

fix.description: take the whole value apart with a pattern (`let S.{ f, g } = q;`, every part bound or `_`), or take the part and leave a value in its place: `mem.replace(&mut q.d, other)` (`import std.mem;`)
